title: Fill density 0.1 lines/mm: 5 rows 10 mm apart, walked along the edge
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 0°, under sewing off, density 0.1 (PE-DESIGN's minimum): five rows 10 mm apart from edge to edge, the needle walking 2 mm stitches along the edge between rows, as in PE-DESIGN's file.

evidence.note: Fill Stitch: Direction, Density, Step pitch, Frequency

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm with the Rectangle tool. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Density at its minimum (0.1), Under sewing unticked, every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default (Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Feathered edge and Gradation off). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN's Density field stops at 0.1 lines/mm

PE-DESIGN 11.50's file, needle point for needle point (±0.15 mm): the row order in halves from the start point, the out-and-back first row, brick row ends, straight ≤ 2 mm travel, Frequency grid from the bounding box and the 0.3 mm tie-in and lock (stitch-rules F3/F6)
